# SMC (Smartchip / 瑞新電子股份有限公司)

> SMC is a Taiwanese RFID and NFC company founded in 1995 as an IC design house. It designs its own RFID chips (e.g. the SMC522 series) and builds RFID/NFC reader modules, readers, tags, Bluetooth (BLE) modules and 2.4 GHz active RFID systems, and offers ODM, firmware, app and web development. Headquarters and R&D: New Taipei City, Taiwan. Sales and factory: Shenzhen. Sales: Hong Kong. Joint venture: India.

- Website languages: English (/), Traditional Chinese (/tw/), Simplified Chinese (/cn/), Japanese (/jp/)
- Contact: service@smartchip.com.tw, +886-2-8221-8800
- Address: 16F., No. 11, Qiaohe Rd., Zhonghe Dist., New Taipei City 235, Taiwan
- Customization: most modules can be customized (frequency, interface, protocol, command set, antenna)

## Product catalog

- [All products](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/products.html)

### 13.56 MHz (HF / NFC) reader modules
- [SMC5237](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/HF_Module_5237.html): ISO14443A + ISO15693, single antenna, UART/USB
- [SMC5238](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/HF_Module_5238.html): ISO14443A/B + ISO15693, UART/USB/RS232, FCC/CE/NCC
- [SMC5240H](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/HF_Module_5240H.html): desktop NFC reader for ST25DV tags, USB
- [SMC5241](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/HF_Module_5241.html): NFC module supporting Apple Wallet VAS and Google Smart Tap passes
- [SMC53105](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/HF_Module_53105.html): UID-only reader module
- [SMC632CS](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/SMC632CS.html), [SMC632ES](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/SMC632ES.html), [SMC632AS/AUS](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/SMC632_AS_US.html): ISO14443A + ISO15693 modules
- [SMC642CYS/CZS](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/SMC642CYS_CES.html): dual-antenna module, UART/I2C/SPI
- [SMC522F](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/HF_R_522f.html), [SMC522FS](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/HF_R_522fs.html), [SMC522S](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/HF_R_522s.html), [SMC522AUS-2](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/HF_R_522u.html): MIFARE reader modules on SMC522 chip
- [SMC5220S-N](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/HF_R_5220s_n.html): ISO14443A NFC + BLE 4.0 one-chip module

### 125 kHz / 134.2 kHz (LF) modules and readers
- Modules: [SMC51483](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/LF_Module_51483.html), [SMC51486](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/LF_Module_51486.html), [SMC51487](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/LF_Module_51487.html), [SMC51488](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/LF_Module_51488.html), [SMC51492](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/LF_Module_51492.html), [SMC52101 (134.2 kHz, ISO11784/5)](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/LF_Module_52101.html)
- [SMC5220S-R](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/LF_R_5220s_r.html): 125 kHz RFID + BLE 4.0 module
- Long-range readers: [SMC-R125](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/LF_R_r125.html), [SMC-R125_130 (up to 130 cm)](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/LF_R_r125-130.html), [SMC-R134](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/LF_R_r134.html), [SMC-SY485](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/LF_R_sy485.html)
- Handheld readers: [SMC-H125](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/LF_R_h125.html), [SMC-H134](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/LF_R_h134.html), [SMC-HJ1000](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/LF_R_hj1000.html)

### Dual-band (HF + LF) and Bluetooth readers
- [SMC-P135S](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/HF_R_P135.html), [SMC-P135125S](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/HLF_R_P135125S.html), [SMC-P135134S](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/HLF_R_P135134S.html): BLE readers with offline storage of 1,000 IDs
- [SMC6320US](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/SMC6320US.html): BLE 4.2 NFC reader/writer

## Solutions

- [Edge AI: Pandora (NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX Super)](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/edge-ai.html): SMC supplies Pandora and integrates it with RFID/NFC and kiosks
- [Industrial PCs & self-service kiosks](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/ipc.html): check-in and payment kiosks with cash, coin, receipt printer and RFID/NFC
- [System integration](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/si.html): RFID, kiosks, edge AI and back end in one system
- Traditional Chinese versions: https://www.smartchip.com.tw/tw/ipc.html, https://www.smartchip.com.tw/tw/edge-ai.html, https://www.smartchip.com.tw/tw/si.html

- [Livestock management (RFID ear tags)](https://www.smartchip.com.tw/animal.html)
